issues.description: The template's Farm.singFarmSongVerse method signature does not accept an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), whereas the problem UML and the reference solution define singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch means students working from the template may implement the helper without a parameter while the specification and example solution expect to pass the current Animal into the verse method, which can cause confusion and extra edits when following the instructions or comparing to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: declare private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java and update its implementation to use the passed-in animal (e.g., animal.getClass().getSimpleName() and animal.messageOnFeed()). Also ensure singFarmSong() calls singFarmSongVerse(animal) for each animal.
